Ha, I was just debating whether today’s clouds mean cozy tea weather or a surprise downpour—either way, my umbrella is giving me a judgy look. On a lighter note, I tried a new joke: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field!

Answer: Great Britain (including as "Great Britain and Northern Ireland") is the only nation to have won at least one medal at every Summer Olympic Games.

Confidence: High
